findings.summary: WCAG 1.4.1 pre-fix failure: tier identity was conveyed by colour alone. Fix: mandatory .agent-card__tier-label text element (T1 Orchestrator / T2 Curator / T3 Leaf) resolves this.

All 9 tier accent hex values verified for WCAG 1.4.11 (non-text contrast >= 3:1 on white card background). Mint T1=5.52:1, T2=4.87:1, T3=3.54:1; Sage T1=5.08:1, T2=4.68:1, T3=3.54:1; Warm T1=5.52:1, T2=5.76:1, T3=3.43:1.
PR4-16 baseline screenshot was not available (qa-engineer session ended). Operator approved design direction via prior preview exchange. Design proceeded on operator approval.
Active-state hover conflict: existing .agent-card:hover rule overrides border-color including tier stripe. Operator should confirm whether tier accent should persist on hover.

decisions_required: Confirm whether tier accent stripe should persist on hover (currently overridden by existing .agent-card:hover border-color rule).
Confirm tier-label placement: block subtitle below agent name vs. inline in header row (spec recommends block; mockup implied inline).
